findings.title: Substantive item bundled on the consent agenda
findings.detail: This item is designated for the consent agenda, meaning it is enacted by a single motion with no separate discussion unless a governing-body member pulls it (with two supporting members). Substantive policy can pass with essentially zero deliberation — request removal from consent if you want it discussed.

findings.title: Ordinance on final (3rd) reading — last scheduled opportunity for input
findings.detail: Third reading is typically the passage vote. Public comment after this point is drastically less effective; this is the last agenda step where input can change the outcome.

findings.detail: Annexation moves land into city jurisdiction and usually precedes zoning/service decisions with long-term effects. Verify the associated zoning-map and service-commitment items posted alongside it.
